title: Correct USERAUTH_REQUEST without prior SERVICE_REQUEST succeeds
quote: The client sends a service request once a secure transport layer connection has been established.
rationale: Directly after the initial KEX, a correct authentication request (no SERVICE_REQUEST sent) is answered with UA_SUCCESS. No MUST/SHOULD forbids it (v1 D1: Dropbear; NDSS 2023). Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D1 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
